“The October Cohort 1 data from ELEVATE-45-201 marked our third consecutive readout demonstrating encouraging safety and tolerability across our clinical programs,” said Dipal Doshi, Chief Executive Officer of Entrada Therapeutics.
The ELEVATE-44-201 Cohort 1 open-label data readout will also include additional functional measures, reflecting nearly a year of treatment.
Topline results met the primary objectives of favorable safety and tolerability.
Vertex is on track to share interim results from the GALILEO study in the second half of 2026.
